column3: Maheswary  Foundation  (Incorporation)
Act, No. 27 of 2011
to promote and protect human rights, values, and
pluralism in Sri Lanka;
to promote sustainable development in rural areas
by utilizing the natural resources available in the
area;
to  promote  agricultural  and  fisheries  sectors  by
introducing  technology  to  obtain  maximum
benefits;
to establish information technology centres island
wide for the advancement of scientific studies;
to  strengthen  the  institutes  of  higher  studies,
encourage research and award scholarships;
to  promote  social  and  cultural  activities  for
enriching different ethnic groups;
to  empower  women,  children,  disabled,  and
underprivileged  people;
to  promote  and  encourage  sports,  literary  and
spiritual  activities  among  pepole;
to  coordinate  with  similar  organizations  of  both
local and foreign and to organize meetings, seminars
conferences etc. for the advancement of its objects;
to  obtain  and  provide  grants  and  other  form  of
financial  assistance  for  the  advancement  of  the
objects;
to  provide  every  assistance  to  governmental
agencies  from  generating  employment  among
youth;
to  provide  lands  and  houses  to  landless  families
and  provide  buildings  and  other  facilities  to
schools;
